integrity: The exact code is included and can be replayed with Python 3 without external dependencies. The universal bound and continuous-optimizer reduction are proved analytically; no external independent verification has been performed.
limitations: The theorem treats the regular root 24-cell and affine images only. The finite root-set census does not itself cover arbitrary interior points, which are handled by a separate determinant-rigidity argument. A different historical formulation of the same classification may exist.
title: Exact largest-simplex volume and equality classification in the regular 24-cell
